bio: The ‘Japanese Jidori’ on the coasters means chicken breeds native to Japan. The chef takes pride in using only such chicken, never mixing them with foreign breeds. The concept here is to eat the entire bird. Rare cuts of chicken are shared between two diners, which is why reservations are only accepted for groups of two or more. To ensure that guests savour the richness of the chicken to the full, there are no dipping sauces. Respect for food producers and passion for yakitori pervade every aspect of Torisen....
